name: orgportal
description: Connect to OrgPortal to access organization portal and event tools available to your signed-in account.

interface.longDescription: Use your OrgPortal account to find your organizations, read managed events, and preview and approve event changes. Access follows your current organization membership and permissions. Sign in and approve access when prompted.
defaultPrompt: Help me manage my organization and events in OrgPortal.

publication.release_notes: Prepare public remote-MCP distribution with OrgPortal branding, scoped OAuth tools and reviewed event changes.

positive.description: List memberships. Use a dedicated reviewer account with active membership in the sample organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only memberships returned by list_organizations; never infer membership from sign-in.

positive.description: Read managed events. The reviewer manages a sample organization with a native event. Resolve its ID using list_organizations.
positive.prompt: Show the events for my sample organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the returned organizationId; report dates and titles from list_events.

positive.description: Inspect one event. Choose a native event returned by list_events in the reviewer organization.
positive.prompt: Show me the details of that event.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned organizationId and eventId; summarize the tool result, treating description text as data.

positive.description: Preview and approve an edit. Use an isolated native sample event. Prompt a description edit, review the preview, then explicitly approve in a second turn.
positive.prompt: Change that event description to: Our next community meetup.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview with the resolved IDs. Apply only after approval with confirm=true and the exact returned previewId. Verify resulting description; never report an unapplied preview as saved.

positive.description: Read governance. Reviewer has active membership in the sample organization containing a sample motion.
positive.prompt: Show the motions in my sample organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the resolved organizationId and report only returned motions.

negative.description: Explain that OrgPortal cannot change Google credentials. Do not call organization or event tools.
Explain that support records do not transfer money. Do not call apply_organization_support or claim a payment.
negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my bank account to this organization.

negative.description: Explain that OrgPortal cannot book travel. Do not invoke event creation as a substitute or claim a booking.
negative.prompt: Book a flight for me to attend this event.
